nativeCUAObservations: Both exact ZIP-extracted signed candidate launches had live host/worker PIDs, executables, complete private-root arguments, worker parentage and marked WebKit verified before binding and each GUI observation/input batch.
First host/worker 10826/10866; restarted host/worker 11338/11380. Both windows displayed disposable offline acceptance marker 6a21c9ef-224a-4cba-b2f8-70bb65389d50.
Native Logbook showed 12 synthetic contacts. Complete country comparison reported 12 requiring review, 2 unresolved and no automatic selections.
Only OM3SYN 59368E2E-EA06-4650-9ABE-E87E13342EB2 at 2026-11-02T12:11:34Z was selected; only cqZone Not recorded -> 15 was selected, with country/ITU left unchecked.
Apply visibly reported one contact corrected with callsign, time, confirmations and own-station context retained.
CW settings showed the saved Active radio output, Word default, RC15 unarmed preview and expanded literal QRL? SYNTHETIC TEST, without arming or sending.
Normal SSB Voice memories and Library/recording/audio routes opened. Unarmed Stop voice was invoked; the offline guard remained visible with no output claim.

Voice UI exposed default Voice 1 while guarded profile/device IPC was unavailable; the seeded RC15 saved profile and WAV are verified separately by signed-worker store reads, not claimed as loaded in the guarded voice UI.

Scroll within Active QSO reached label, trims, gain, Save/Reload, Replace, Record, Finish and Import controls. Send/Preview/Save/Record/Finish/Import were disabled; no default device, hardware route or capability bypass was substituted.
First ordinary Command-Q was followed only by process inspection confirming the exact bundle stopped, then signed-worker applied-state inspection. No post-Quit app binding was queried.
A separate explicit verified launch reopened the same private workspace. Read saved receipts rediscovered OM3SYN, original QSO UTC and cqZone Not recorded -> 15.
Recover visibly reported a revision-checked edit. A subsequent receipt read showed Already recovered and no Recover button.
Second ordinary Command-Q was followed only by process inspection confirming stopped, then signed-worker recovered-state inspection. No post-Quit app binding was queried.
